items.title: Here Are Tuesday’s Top Wall Street Analyst Research Calls: Amgen, Baidu, Best Buy, Circle Internet, Corning, Intel, Lockheed Martin SpaceX, TeraWulf and More
items.summary: Wall Street returns from summer vacation to a market suddenly bracing for a rate hike, with fresh analyst calls on Intel, Lockheed Martin, Amgen, and SpaceX adding more pressure points to an already tense week.

items.title: Eaton Shares Rise After UBS Upgrade to Buy
items.summary: Eaton (NYSE:ETN) shares rose 3. 1% in premarket trading after UBS upgraded the power management company to Buy from Neutral and increased its price target to $515 from $450.

items.title: Premarket movers: Energy stocks rise on Iran tensions, Eaton jumps on UBS upgrade
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. stock futures fell early Tuesday, kicking off a shortened trading week as Wall Street monitored the U.S.-Iran conflict alongside rising trade tensions between Canada and the U.S. Futures tied to the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.8% by 05:30 ET (09:30 GMT). S&P 500 futures fell 0.3% and Nasdaq-100 futures slipped 0.1%. U.S. markets were closed Monday for Labor Day.

items.title: Is Eaton (ETN) Cheap As It Doubles Fibrebond Capacity With A $242 Million Expansion?
items.summary: Eaton (ETN) is committing more than US$242 million to a new 1 million square foot facility in North Little Rock, Arkansas. The facility is intended to double Fibrebond’s U.S. capacity for customized electrical enclosures. For Eaton, the Arkansas expansion comes after a strong run in the share price, with a year to date share price return of 21.33%, even though the stock has pulled back with a 30 day share price decline of 10.71%.
